name: Ogawa Naoko
source:
The daughter of foreign aid workers, Naoko has spent a significant amount of her life growing up in other countries. While her parents are away on assignment, Naoko keeps house and looks kindly after her little brother, [url=http://vndb.org/c2033]Kazuki[/url].

[from [url=http://www.shira-oka.com/characters/29-ogawa-naoko.html]official site[/url]]
